scope: Pre-execution review of one proposed marked standalone B1 positive fixture; no test execution.
authorized_scope_from_parent: User allows narrowly scoped synchronous diagnostic markers; one outside-repository positive reference, negative/original comparisons conditional on mandatory named native result.
required_shape: Keep builtin node:test function import and direct top-level test(e1-native-positive, callback).
Keep explicit assert.equal(2+2,4) inside the actual callback.
Use synchronous fs.writeSync(2,...) only for before/after registration call and before/after actual arithmetic assertion.
No registration wrapper, catch suppression, async registration, custom reporter, D1 collector/preload, or exit override.
Preserve exact fixture bytes/hash, absolute /tmp path and fresh cwd, native argv, environment and separate raw streams.
Named individual native PASS remains required; markers cannot replace it.
Any missing named PASS stops all later negative/original comparison executions.
marker_limits: Registration markers establish source reachability/call return only, not native registration acknowledgment.
Callback markers can establish this marked fixture callback/assertion reachability; they cannot prove original unmarked E1 callback behavior.
Synchronous writes reduce asynchronous observer effects, but the reference remains diagnostic instrumentation with a distinct purpose; no historical outcome is rewritten.
Marker I/O errors remain fatal and cannot be treated as a production or comparator defect.
